note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect and until is derived by hand from the 50-wire topology and the p.85 tree-circuit rule, not printed. No erratum touches Book IV p.85. Topology: the tree root is the minus rail on 3V; switch 3 set 2 sends it LEFT to 4V (switch 4 set 2, then relay 2, then relays 3/4) or RIGHT to 5V (switch 5 set 2, then relay 1, then relays 5/6). Relay 1 follows switch 4, relay 2 switch 5, relays 3-6 switch 6, so the stop pad is 8*sw3 + 4*sw4 + 2*sw5 + 1*sw6 with LEFT = 1 (p.80 convention, O-C12). Script choices, not printed: the four single-bit values 8, 4, 2, 1 pin the bit weight of each switch, 13 and 6 reach two further leaves (4G and 6J), each value is reached by a dial run from the previous one, and a final pushbutton 6 press with the dial already on the selected pad checks that it does not move. Construction state is switches LEFT, dial on D0. pushbutton 6 hold length, 500 ms switch settles and the 12000 ms until windows are script choices sized for a run rate as slow as 25 rpm; rotary rate, coast and geometry are profile fallbacks (O-R1, O-R3, O-R5). Digest is a placeholder for the runner.
